articles.summary: Black Stone Minerals, L.P. (NYSE: BSM) ("Black Stone Minerals," "Black Stone," or "the Partnership") today announces its financial and operating results for the third quarter of 2026. Financial and Operational Highlights Net income for the third quarter was $52.4 million, and Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter totaled $104.1 million.
